approach: The 360 default.xex statically recompiled to x86-64 C++ with ReXGlue: a game-specific runtime stands in for the Xbox, and the SDK's Xenos renderer draws on Vulkan only.
notes: Plays at the console's 60 fps on Windows and natively on Linux and the Steam Deck (no Proton): menus, character select and full fights with every character tried, Survival included; up to 4K internal on PC, 720p on the Deck. Known: on the Deck a two- or three-second dip after a KO in Survival. Same Team Ninja engine as the Dead or Alive Xtreme 2 recomp. No version yet. No game data included: bring your own Xbox 360 copy.
